note: Leadville Ranger District campground in aspen and lodgepole along Lake Creek, on CO-82 west of Twin Lakes Reservoir and Twin Lakes Village (from Leadville, 15 mi south on US-24 then west on CO-82), ~9,500 ft, with a view of Parry Peak; the Continental Divide Trail is just down the road. Two loops: a ring north of the highway entrance and a spur road south along the creek. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov: confirmed 25 FCFS sites, $28, vault toilets, no water. Added season (May-Sept, weather dependent), extra-vehicle fee, firewood, senior/access 50%, FCFS details. No length published anywhere (the inclusion note's '~30 ft' has no source); none recorded. Note rewritten: elevation corrected to the FS's 9,500 ft, field facts removed.
flags: Website: stored https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc is the forest home page; the campground's own FS page is https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/parry-peak-campground (live, updated Feb 3, 2026). recreation.gov facility 10165525 is FCFS Scan-and-Pay only.
Phone (none stored): Leadville Ranger District 719-486-0749 (FS page contact). recreation.gov's facility-specific line is the concessionaire's (661) 702-1420 (tbolton@goexplorus.com).

Length: neither the FS page nor recreation.gov states any maximum; the catalog has no lengths (4 placeholder Scan-and-Pay sites). The inclusion_evidence's 'sites accommodate trailers up to ~30 ft' is unsourced. Satellite shows ordinary gravel loops; no reason to doubt a 23-ft rig, but nothing written to cite.

Independence Pass length limit: CDOT bars vehicles (or vehicle+trailer) 35 ft or longer on CO-82 between MP 47.2 (near Aspen) and MP 84.2 (east side, near Twin Lakes, about a mile west of US-24) (CDOT 2022 release; the 2026 opening release repeats the 35-ft ban). Parry Peak is on CO-82 west of Twin Lakes Village, so it lies INSIDE the restricted stretch even when approached from Leadville without crossing the pass. A 23-ft rig is well under 35 ft; no criteria problem for EKKO, but the 35-ft cap applies to anyone reaching the campground by CO-82 from either side.

Waterfront re-audit lead (stored not waterfront, not changed): FS 'along Lake Creek'; recreation.gov 'along the whitewaters of Lake Creek'. On Esri imagery the southern spur road runs down the creek's west bank with pullouts ~10-30 m from the water through scattered conifers; Lake Creek is ~10 m wide here, so any on-water value would be creekside. The north loop is 60-150 m back. Pads aren't individually legible and there are no per-site points.
Pin 39.06712,-106.4095 (FS and recreation.gov coordinate) is at the campground entrance off the CO-82 hairpin, ~100-200 m from both loops. OK.

Status: season over (FCFS season 2026 ended Sept 6). The Willow Fire closure (02-12-01-26-39, Leadville RD) covers NFS lands south of Turquoise Lake to Halfmoon Creek, well north of Lake Creek; Parry Peak is not in it.
